item.title: Everllence Develops Hydrogen-Capable 4-Stroke Test Bench
item.description: A research-engine test bench at Everllence’s Augsburg site has been upgraded to enable hydrogen combustion.The new development occurred under the umbrella of the HydroPoLEn project, an Everllence partnership with industry leaders and research institutes.
